page.overview:
Who is Pedrus Almeidus?

Pedrus Almeidus was a reporter for The New York Ghost in the 1920s.

He wrote an article about a call by MACUSA officials for more witches in the workforce that was published in the paper's 6 December 1926 morning edition.
